range_note: Illustrative +/-15% band around each point estimate: communicates typical within-state variation, not a statistical confidence interval.
anchor_vintage: NFDA 2023 Member General Price List Study national medians - the latest published NFDA price study - inflated to August 2026 dollars.

inflation.series: CPI-U, U.S. city average, 'Funeral expenses', not seasonally adjusted
inflation.why_december_2023: The NFDA 2023 Member GPL Study is the price study fielded in calendar 2023; December 2023 is the year-end reference point for chaining into 2024.

chain.note: Released Jan 15, 2025; Table 2 row: Funeral expenses(1)(6) | 0.157 | 3.0 | 0.3
Released Jan 13, 2026; Table 2 row reports 2.6 (the 5.6% figure belongs to Jan 2026)
Largest single-month move in the window; 12-mo in this release = 5.6%

caveats: BLS publishes percent changes rounded to one decimal; the chained product inherits roughly 0.1-0.2pp of rounding error.
Only not-seasonally-adjusted (NSA) values are used, so the Oct/Nov 2025 SA gaps from the 2025 appropriations lapse are irrelevant.
The April 2026 rebasing of some CPI series to December 2024=100 does not affect percent changes, so chaining is unaffected.

geography_vintage: BEA Regional Price Parities, 2024 (official release February 19, 2026; next release December 10, 2026).
rpp_source: BEA Interactive Data Application, Table SARPP (all-items, goods, services components), pulled 2026-09-23, cross-checked against the Feb 19, 2026 release.
refresh_cadence: Annual: each spring the dataset rebuilds from the newest BEA release, the newest published NFDA study, and the latest BLS CPI funeral-expenses data.

optional_features.religious_traditions: Optional calculator toggles adjust specific line items per tradition (never a blanket multiplier). Figures are sourced provider/regional examples, not a national survey; see data/research_religious_costs.md.
optional_features.va_benefits: Optional deductions using current VA.gov allowance amounts; must be claimed, amounts reset Oct 1.
optional_features.upkeep: Perpetual-care explainer plus optional marker-upkeep range from a 2025 NY state-approved price list.
optional_features.cash_advances: Clergy honoraria and death certificates added as optional items; industry ranges, not surveyed prices.
optional_features.body_donation: Optional disposition path with strong acceptance-not-guaranteed disclaimers.
